sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:70

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:70:1
items.html: The upper point of Tzion, which is in Bina, is within it, although it is not recognizable; and there is found in it revealed male power and hidden female power. Meaning, that what he says — that the Yesod is not from Bina because it is male — is the discernment of the male power in it, which is the discernment of the direct light that is in the Yesod. However, the discernment of the screen in it, upon which the coupling by striking is made, is drawn from Bina, and it is called hidden female power; that is to say, the discernment of the screen that repels the light to its posterior and hides it, whereby the reflected light rises and clothes the direct light, as is known.
